answer: Grant newcomers only probationary standing that matures across epochs: a new identity starts with faint weight, like a pigment wash barely marking the page, and earns full standing only after many epochs of consistent honest work, each epoch adding a layer, steady as basalt settling into rock. A sybil farm must keep a thousand puppets active and well-behaved for the whole voyage, paying constant upkeep, while one honest agent waits once. Limits: newcomers face a long delay before full rights, patient attackers can still age accounts, and grading honest probation fairly needs reliable history.
